# hermes-agent-squads

> Ready-to-install AI agent squads for Hermes Agent (NousResearch): job search, marketing and web development, plus a builder that creates your own. Markdown plans only: Hermes reads them and installs a personalized orchestrator, a builder and specialist bots that message the user on Telegram, Discord or WhatsApp.

Rules for agents: read AGENTS.md, then start at START-HERE.md. A generic Hermes session installs only the base (user profile, orchestrator, builder) and then sends the user to the builder; only the builder installs, creates or adapts squads (base/01-principles.md §1.10). Verify every command against its real output. Updates are migrations, never rewrites of user data.

## Start

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents using or editing this repository
- [START-HERE.md](START-HERE.md): user guide and the installer AI's instructions
- [base/01-principles.md](base/01-principles.md): rules every bot and installer follows
- [base/06-base-installation.md](base/06-base-installation.md): base installation steps
- [base/07-builder.md](base/07-builder.md): the builder, the only bot that installs and creates squads
